task_description: Add LetsView screen capture as a new video source for the Matanglawin crack detection system. This enables capturing frames from the DJI Fly app mirrored via LetsView to a Windows laptop. The implementation adds a new letsview_source.py module, integrates it into the existing source registry and detector pipeline, and handles reconnection, window minimization, and resize gracefully.

verification.summary: All imports work. LetsViewSource gracefully returns open:False on Linux. Registry includes 'letsview' with correct label. Detector imports and handles reconnection correctly. Docker image builds successfully. Semantic review APPROVED on v2.
